title: Hold, Dispute and Correction Terms by Keyturn Host Payout Schedule
content:
Stopping money from leaving a Keyturn Host Payout Account, answering a payout dispute and correcting an entry all run to periods the schedule sets. Those periods are stated below.

## Terms by schedule

| Payout schedule | Notice before a hold | Hold review period | Host's time to answer a dispute | Correction window | Largest correction without escalation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 0 days | 5 business days | 7 business days | 60 days | 500.00 USD |
| Weekly Batch | 1 day | 5 business days | 7 business days | 60 days | 750.00 USD |
| Express | 1 day | 4 business days | 7 business days | 90 days | 1000.00 USD |
| Instant | 1 day | 3 business days | 5 business days | 90 days | 1000.00 USD |
| Fleet Settlement | 3 days | 7 business days | 14 business days | 120 days | 5000.00 USD |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | 5 days | 10 business days | 21 business days | 180 days | 10000.00 USD |

## Reading of each term

**Notice before a hold** is the calendar days' notice the host is given before money is held: none at all on the Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule, 1 day on the three schedules that follow it, 3 days on the Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule and 5 days on the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule.

**Hold review period** is the business days a hold is reviewed within, and **the host's time to answer a dispute** the business days the host has to answer a payout dispute.

**Correction window** is the calendar days after an entry within which it may be corrected, and **largest correction without escalation** the largest correction that may be made without escalation.

## Points of judgement

The correction window and the correction ceiling move together up the ladder: 60 days and 500.00 USD on the Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule; 60 days and 750.00 USD on the Keyturn Weekly Batch Payout Schedule; 90 days and 1000.00 USD on the Keyturn Express Payout Schedule and the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule; 120 days and 5000.00 USD on the Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule; and 180 days and 10000.00 USD on the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule.
